datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.description: Which series to pull. Choices: dwellings (mean residential dwelling price and dwelling counts), inflation (consumer price index), wages (wage price index).

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: Names to match, e.g. ["Australia"], ["New South Wales","Victoria"]. Matching is partial. Leave empty for every region the dataset publishes.

periods.title: Periods
periods.description: How many recent periods per series. These datasets are quarterly.

allMeasures.title: All measures
allMeasures.description: By default each dataset returns its headline measure only, for example mean dwelling price rather than total dwelling stock value. Turn this on to return every measure, which mixes very different units on the same output.
